value.rationale: Complete bipartite graphs isolate a natural source-design question with no dependence on tie-breaking at neighbors. Reweighting reduces the linear excess of uniform vertex sampling to order √N at unequal limiting proportions; within this best scale, the nonzero quantile correction strictly improves the leading excess coefficient over exact quota balancing. The asymmetric completion profile determines deadline probabilities for all local weights, independent of the mean criterion. This is informative for the fixed i.i.d. design family without claiming superiority to adaptive or periodic schedules.
